<!--
  Widget: Cuba Pre-Estiramiento (12 rodillos + 3 estaciones vapor/calentador/condensado)
  Portado desde la vista de proceso "Pre-Estiramiento" de PsiCore.

  Es un solo SVG con viewBox fijo (0 0 860 350) y width/height:100% en CSS,
  así que escala proporcionalmente sea cual sea el tamaño que le den en el
  lienzo (respeta el defaultWidth/defaultHeight de widget.json como punto
  de partida, pero no se rompe si lo agrandan o achican).
-->
<svg class="pei-svg" viewBox="0 0 860 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Cuba Pre-Estiramiento con 12 rodillos y 3 estaciones de vapor, calentador y condensado" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>

  <defs>
    <!-- Acero cepillado: degradado radial centrado y suave, contraste claro centro → borde -->
    <radialGradient id="pei-steel" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F4F7FB"/>
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#E9EEF5"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#D3DCE8"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#AEBDD1"/>
      <stop offset="86%" stop-color="#7E90AB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4A5874"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Bisel del borde: luz en arco superior-izquierdo, sombra inferior-derecha -->
    <linearGradient id="pei-bevel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F2F6FC"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#9AACC4"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#5A6B87"/>
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#2A3752"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#101A2E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Brillo especular suave (se difumina con filtro) -->
    <radialGradient id="pei-spec" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity=".9"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity=".32"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Eje/hub: centro claro, borde apenas más oscuro; los números van en oscuro encima -->
    <radialGradient id="pei-hub" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F5F8FC"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#E2E9F2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C2CEDD"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="pei-blur" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.1"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Fibra: envuelve el lado cercano de cada rodillo; rodillos 6 y 7 a la misma altura (quiebre real de la máquina) -->
  <path d="M-5.3,10.0 L39.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 60.3,50.0 L103.7,106.0 A13,13 0 0 0 124.3,106.0 L167.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 188.3,50.0 L231.7,106.0 A13,13 0 0 0 252.3,106.0 L295.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 316.3,50.0 L359.7,106.0 A13,13 0 0 0 370.0,111.0 L434.0,111.0 A13,13 0 0 0 444.3,106.0 L487.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 508.3,50.0 L551.7,106.0 A13,13 0 0 0 572.3,106.0 L615.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 636.3,50.0 L679.7,106.0 A13,13 0 0 0 700.3,106.0 L743.7,50.0 A13,13 0 0 1 764.3,50.0 L814.3,5.0"
        fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g class="pei-roller">
    <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="13"/><circle cx="114" cy="98" r="13"/><circle cx="178" cy="58" r="13"/><circle cx="242" cy="98" r="13"/>
    <circle cx="306" cy="58" r="13"/><circle cx="370" cy="98" r="13"/><circle cx="434" cy="98" r="13"/><circle cx="498" cy="58" r="13"/>
    <circle cx="562" cy="98" r="13"/><circle cx="626" cy="58" r="13"/><circle cx="690" cy="98" r="13"/><circle cx="754" cy="58" r="13"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bisel del borde -->
  <g class="pei-roller-bevel">
    <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="12.3"/><circle cx="114" cy="98" r="12.3"/><circle cx="178" cy="58" r="12.3"/><circle cx="242" cy="98" r="12.3"/>
    <circle cx="306" cy="58" r="12.3"/><circle cx="370" cy="98" r="12.3"/><circle cx="434" cy="98" r="12.3"/><circle cx="498" cy="58" r="12.3"/>
    <circle cx="562" cy="98" r="12.3"/><circle cx="626" cy="58" r="12.3"/><circle cx="690" cy="98" r="12.3"/><circle cx="754" cy="58" r="12.3"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Relieve oscuro en el borde interno (zócalo del bisel) -->
  <g class="pei-roller-rim">
    <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="10.7"/><circle cx="114" cy="98" r="10.7"/><circle cx="178" cy="58" r="10.7"/><circle cx="242" cy="98" r="10.7"/>
    <circle cx="306" cy="58" r="10.7"/><circle cx="370" cy="98" r="10.7"/><circle cx="434" cy="98" r="10.7"/><circle cx="498" cy="58" r="10.7"/>
    <circle cx="562" cy="98" r="10.7"/><circle cx="626" cy="58" r="10.7"/><circle cx="690" cy="98" r="10.7"/><circle cx="754" cy="58" r="10.7"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Brillo especular difuminado (arriba-izquierda) y eje central -->
  <g class="pei-roller-spec" filter="url(#pei-blur)">
    <circle cx="45.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="109.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="173.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="237.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/>
    <circle cx="301.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="365.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="429.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="493.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/>
    <circle cx="557.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="621.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="685.8" cy="92.6" r="4.6"/><circle cx="749.8" cy="52.6" r="4.6"/>
  </g>
  <g class="pei-roller-hub">
    <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="3.6"/><circle cx="114" cy="98" r="3.6"/><circle cx="178" cy="58" r="3.6"/><circle cx="242" cy="98" r="3.6"/>
    <circle cx="306" cy="58" r="3.6"/><circle cx="370" cy="98" r="3.6"/><circle cx="434" cy="98" r="3.6"/><circle cx="498" cy="58" r="3.6"/>
    <circle cx="562" cy="98" r="3.6"/><circle cx="626" cy="58" r="3.6"/><circle cx="690" cy="98" r="3.6"/><circle cx="754" cy="58" r="3.6"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#16233C" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="50" y="61">1</text><text x="114" y="101">2</text><text x="178" y="61">3</text><text x="242" y="101">4</text>
    <text x="306" y="61">5</text><text x="370" y="101">6</text><text x="434" y="101">7</text><text x="498" y="61">8</text>
    <text x="562" y="101">9</text><text x="626" y="61">10</text><text x="690" y="101">11</text><text x="754" y="61">12</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cuba pre-estiramiento -->
  <text x="422" y="145" text-anchor="middle" fill="#33415C" font-family="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">CUBA PRE-ESTIRAMIENTO</text>
  <rect x="15" y="150" width="815" height="42" rx="6" fill="#1B2A47" stroke="#223151"/>
  <rect class="pei-tankfill" x="19" y="168" width="807" height="20" rx="3"/>

  <!-- ESTACION 1 -->
  <rect x="162" y="160" width="32" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <path d="M166,168 L171,162 L176,174 L181,162 L186,174 L190,168" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="170" y1="176" x2="170" y2="192" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="170" y1="192" x2="170" y2="250" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M160,256 170,262 160,268 Z M180,256 170,262 180,268 Z" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="170" y1="268" x2="170" y2="320" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="186" y1="176" x2="186" y2="298" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <!-- ESTACION 2 -->
  <rect x="388" y="160" width="32" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <path d="M392,168 L397,162 L402,174 L407,162 L412,174 L416,168" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="396" y1="176" x2="396" y2="192" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="396" y1="192" x2="396" y2="250" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M386,256 396,262 386,268 Z M406,256 396,262 406,268 Z" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="396" y1="268" x2="396" y2="320" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="412" y1="176" x2="412" y2="298" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <!-- ESTACION 3 -->
  <rect x="610" y="160" width="32" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <path d="M614,168 L619,162 L624,174 L629,162 L634,174 L638,168" fill="none" stroke="#E8EEF7" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="618" y1="176" x2="618" y2="192" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="618" y1="192" x2="618" y2="250" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M608,256 618,262 608,268 Z M628,256 618,262 628,268 Z" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="618" y1="268" x2="618" y2="320" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="634" y1="176" x2="634" y2="298" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <!-- Lineas horizontales: Condensado (arriba) y Vapor (abajo), estáticas -->
  <line class="pei-flow" x1="45" y1="298" x2="800" y2="298" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="15" y="291" fill="#22C55E" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9">LINEA CONDENSADO</text>
  <line class="pei-flow" x1="45" y1="320" x2="800" y2="320" stroke="#FB923C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="15" y="337" fill="#FB923C" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="9">VAPOR 15 BAR</text>
</svg>
